intro: Abstract paintings that emerge out of an intuitive process, where layers of colour, texture, and gesture evoke the tension between holding on and letting go. Her work exposes this complex and often contradictory nature of inner transformation.
description: Explore the abstract paintings of Toronto artist Carla Gusek. Browse her portfolio and enquire about available artwork.
about_text: Painting is both a creative practice and a means of self-discovery for Carla Gusek. Working in abstraction allows her to embrace uncertainty, follow curiosity, and create paintings that remain open to interpretation.
